accountLead: Manage it all in one place: every data source works with one connection and one balance. No other sign-ups and no API keys.
webAccount: The web version is open with this account.
modeHint: Automatic uses your key when there is one, else credits.
getKey: Open an account, get a key
viaNone: Not usable: enter a key or connect your account.
creditOffer: Credit price: $1 of provider price ≈ {credits} credits
noCreditOffer: This source is not offered on credits right now.
privacy: With your own key, requests go straight to the provider. On credits they pass through octopuson; their contents are not kept.
assistantKey: With this key the assistant is asked directly on your account. Without it, AI visibility asks it through DataForSEO (your own key or credits).
viaNoneAssistant: No key; AI visibility asks this assistant through DataForSEO.
accountPoint1: DataForSEO, Serper, Yandex and more with one connection
accountPoint2: No provider accounts, no API keys to enter
accountPoint3: One balance; you pay only for the requests you make
choiceLead: There are two ways to use paid data. One is enough; you do not need to set up both.
ownLead: Already have accounts with the providers? Enter your keys; requests go straight to the provider.
ownPoint1: You pay the provider directly and use no credits
ownPoint2: You enter each source's key yourself
ownPoint3: Mix them if you like: your key for some sources, credits for others
providersHint: Enter your own key for each source, or connect your account above.
providersConnected: Your account is connected: the sources run on credits. Nothing needs changing here.
useOwnKey: Use my own key for this source
